# Arete-27B

Nous Research · released 2026-11

Nous Research SFT-only fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (card base\_model), 'post-trained ... to reinforce western values', teacher Inkling, text-only data, vision encoder frozen, MTP head disabled in training; evaluated checkpoint step 1,202. Repo created 2026-11-06. Training context 64k; the card states no inference context length, so none recorded. Intended 'for general assistance and agentic work where users want this change in viewpoint'. No official Ollama entry (404).

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/NousResearch/Arete-27B)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/NousResearch/Arete-27B/blob/108f0afbdcfaa1ceeda4a635004304dfff6d4da2/README.md)

Published measurements are available, but there is not enough shared evaluation data to calculate a comparable overall score yet.

## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Arete-27B (Q4_K_M, needs ~16.7 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF/blob/9762c8502a79bd2b8634735d75f426b9febe092c/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~32.9 GB) `llama cli -hf bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Arete-27B (Q4_K_M, needs ~16.7 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF/blob/9762c8502a79bd2b8634735d75f426b9febe092c/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~32.9 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Arete-27B (Q4_K_M, needs ~16.7 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF/blob/9762c8502a79bd2b8634735d75f426b9febe092c/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run hf.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~32.9 GB) `ollama run hf.co/bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF:Q8_0`
